content:
I ran into the need for a few simp lemmas like pure x *> y = y which I think should be in Lean.

Does this need an RFC? Since it's just a few lines I went ahead and submitted lean4#13865 but please let me know if I should have gone with an RFC first.
See also https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/270676-lean4/topic/Lemmas.20for.20seqLeft.20and.20seqRight/near/579819789 for a question about how to state these lemmas
